sources.label: Official Helly Hansen Size Chart (Women's Jackets, CM)

audit: Old /size-guide 404s. Women's Jackets table, CM view. Old M 92/76/100 now 94/76/102; old XL 100/84/108 now 108/90/116; old 2XL 106/90/114 now XXL 116/98/124. XXXL-5XL added. UK/US/EU removed (not printed on the chart). Printed 'Chest' stored as chest, as on Frugi; the matcher reads it as bust. Separate Women's Plus Size table (1X-3X) not merged: its inch column is ranges but its cm column single values.
